purpose: Bind the launch path from rights evidence through lawful scale without allowing a later stage to bypass an earlier gate.

stages.exit_criteria: Exact approved head is atomically landed on protected main.
At least one source has immutable source-content evidence and explicit collect, store, derive and commercial-use rights for the intended product purpose.
stages.release_condition: Purpose-specific written permission or licensed feed terms plus governed snapshot receipt.

stages.exit_criteria: Each active source is terminalized to PASS, CONDITIONAL, HOLD or NO_GO with evidence; WIP never exceeds six.
stages.release_condition: Provider-specific execution receipt with observed_at and evidence reference; ACTIVE is queue assignment, not execution proof.

stages.exit_criteria: One or two sources independently pass product value, purpose rights, immutable snapshot and source-specific schema gates.
stages.release_condition: Authoritative value, rights, snapshot and schema receipts for the same source ID.

stages.exit_criteria: A rights-and-schema-eligible adapter passes the pre-registered claim-specific sample policy; rights remain a per-event census.
stages.release_condition: Eligible source plus a sealed sampling plan, exact confidence bound, independent-owner coverage and validated provenance manifest.

stages.exit_criteria: Every admitted event in the selected cohort has run ID, source snapshot digest, rights receipt, schema version and event digest persisted in remotely verified PostgreSQL with RLS, PITR and restore evidence.
stages.release_condition: Protected runtime provisioning and remote PostgreSQL/PITR validation.

stages.exit_criteria: The same immutable, policy-qualified cohort completes Evidence, Track B assessment, staging replay and server-owned Projection with digest continuity.
stages.release_condition: Stages 2 through 6 pass and an official Track B assessment is approved.

stages.exit_criteria: Eight verticals, 32 independent source owners and 40000 lawful current-SOLD events meet freshness, provenance, rights and rollback controls.
stages.release_condition: Stage 7 passes for the bounded launch cell before scale admission.

platform_principles.autonomous_effect: A scheduled validator derives bounded counters from authoritative inputs, rejects manual promotion and keeps unresolved external work on HOLD.
platform_principles.global_effect: A claim-specific statistically governed pilot is an enforced prerequisite to the eight-vertical, 32-owner, 40000-event scale target.
platform_principles.irreplaceable_value_effect: Rights, snapshot, schema, run and event digests accumulate in KIDULTS-owned receipts independent of provider identity.
platform_principles.transparency_effect: Every blocked stage names its observed count, evidence dependency and release condition.
